input.task: Write a custom Smithers workflow UI bundle (single self-contained .tsx) for the workflow keyed "ui-eval-fixture". That workflow runs these tasks in order: plan, build, flaky (which intentionally FAILS), report, then a "signoff" approval gate, so the run parks waiting-approval. Build a live dashboard scoped to the ?runId in location.search that: (1) shows the run’s live status; (2) streams the live event feed and surfaces EVERY task node, including the failed "flaky" node with its error message; (3) renders the "report" node’s output; (4) lists pending approvals with a working Approve button. Handle loading/empty/error states and mount with createGatewayReactRoot.
